title: The artifact gate's Bash branch asks the door where a redirect lands
intention: bin/cmd/artifactgate's Bash branch resolves each redirect target against the command's effective directory (a leading `cd <dir> &&`, else the hook's cwd) and refuses only when cairn.tools.artifact door.locate() of that absolute path is a record — the same question the Edit/Write branch asks; a write verb with no redirect keeps today's text rule.
